body:
A campus minister recently wrote that she had used We Make the Road by Walking as their curriculum last year.

 For We Make the Road, we followed the suggested format of the book and went around the circle reading. We used the liturgical resources in the back to open or close. Myself and my colleague who “led” also read your commentary (which was wonderful) . For college students or any group of adults really my only suggestion is to incorporate and use the commentary with the book. It really helps give an extra layer of connection to the narrative shape you put together.

Its a tremendous resource and huge gift. I really recommend it to anyone.
